The GliMR Task Forces are collaborative working groups focused on advancing glioma and brain tumour MRI through research, harmonisation, education and clinical translation. Advanced MRI Advancing the development, validation and clinical translation of innovative MRI techniques and imaging biomarkers for glioma research and patient care. Learn more → Preclinical MRI Bridging preclinical and clinical MRI research by harmonising imaging protocols and translating experimental findings into clinical applications. Learn more → Artificial Intelligence Developing, validating and implementing trustworthy AI solutions for MRI-based glioma analysis, treatment monitoring and clinical decision support. Learn more → Data Sharing Promoting open science by improving the discoverability, accessibility and reuse of brain tumour imaging datasets across the research community. Learn more → Clinical Implementation Facilitating the adoption of advanced MRI techniques in routine clinical practice through guidelines, consensus building and evidence-based recommendations. Learn more → Networking Connecting researchers, clinicians, industry partners and international initiatives to strengthen collaboration, education and funding opportunities. Learn more → Education Providing educational resources, training opportunities and mentorship to support excellence in glioma MRI research and clinical practice. Learn more → Science Communication Communicating glioma MRI research to scientific, clinical and public audiences through accessible, engaging and impactful outreach activities. Learn more →
